results.name: Compact name-only headers align with continuous vertical pillars, no percentage text
Simple work form exposes only core fields and supports direct creation
Handwritten previous/next week text autosaves, summarizes actual records and survives view remount
Selecting part of a pillar opens prefilled reassignment and only the selected period transfers
When nobody remains responsible the source period is grey and a pause warning appears
Reassignment conflict preserves selected dates and target for retry
Drag handle moves entire work with autosave; fixed tabs retain their positions
Month, quarter, year and mobile preserve one continuous bar rather than daily copies
